PFC Lokomotiv Plovdiv, commonly known as Loko Plovdiv, is a Bulgarian professional association football club based in Plovdiv. Lokomotiv's home ground is the Hristo Bonev Stadium, which is situated in Lauta Park and has a capacity of 10,000 spectators.
